<thought>Using the most intense ion at m/z 193.110 as the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺, the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈ 192.103 Da. The formula C₈H₁₆O₅ has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 192.0998 Da (M+H = 193.1070 Da), which is within ~17 ppm of the observed value and fits the isotopic pattern reasonably. No other reasonable C/H/O combination matches the mass as closely. Therefore the molecular formula is C8H16O5.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H16O5</final_answer>
